# Hoopito Launch Screen Assets

These transparent 1x/2x/3x images show the approved orange, one-eyed basketball
mascot used by the Flutter entry animation's first frame. They are deterministic
derivatives of `assets/icons/hoopito-app-icon-foreground.png`, at the same
initial 0.78 scale, generated by
`tool/release/generate_entry_assets.py` and are distributed under the
repository MIT License.
